fields.statement: Testscript run-autonomous starts a two-agent workflow with --autonomous on fake rex and claude: a dry run prints "autonomous": true and launches nothing; the journal's started entry has "autonomous":true; run status --json gives "autonomous": true and the markdown '- Autonomous: yes'; the fake agent logs RHIZA_AUTONOMOUS=1; after the wait stop, run resume without the flag launches step two with RHIZA_AUTONOMOUS=1.
